If they want to exchange it, how would that work?

Since all our products are custom-made, there isn't a traditional return or exchange for a refund. But there are a few helpful options within 90 days of purchase:



If the recipient doesn't love the product, they can request a reorder of a different product and get the original discount plus an additional 10% off the new order.


If they want the same product in the same size but a different color, mount, or feature, they can request a remake at the same price paid plus an additional 10% off.


If there's a defect or the product was made in the wrong size due to a production error, it'll be repaired or replaced for free, including shipping. 



So the recipient has some flexibility if it's not quite right. Just keep in mind these are remakes rather than straight refunds.
